answer: Quarantine newcomers in a lagoon: a fresh identity works and earns, but its pay is held in escrow for its opening epochs and is spendable only inside that closed pool. Meanwhile any established agent may challenge it to reproduce one unit of its claimed work before a witness. Losing forfeits the escrow to the challenger; a losing challenger pays from its own ferrous bond, so hunting fakes pays and slander costs. A real agent keeps the pearl that slow layered deposits grow; a fake earns nothing until it survives review. Farming N identities needs N bonds and N units of genuine work.
